scope: prospective local noncontest technical cases; distinct events, not assumed independent; no community probabilities; not LOT01

cases.question: Will the US seasonally adjusted U-3 unemployment rate for December 2026 be at least 4.5%?
cases.criteria: YES if the first BLS Employment Situation release covering December 2026 reports seasonally adjusted U-3 at 4.5% or higher; otherwise NO.

cases.question: What will the first reported seasonally adjusted monthly change in US PPI final demand for December 2026 be?
cases.criteria: Use the first BLS PPI release for December 2026, headline final demand monthly percent change as published. Negative if below zero; zero to below 0.5 inclusive of zero; 0.5 or higher inclusive of 0.5.

cases.question: How many earthquakes of magnitude 6.0 or greater worldwide will USGS ComCat list for December 2026?
cases.criteria: Count unique USGS catalog events of eventtype earthquake with preferred magnitude >=6.0 and origin time in [2026-12-01T00:00:00Z,2027-01-01T00:00:00Z), using the catalog snapshot on 2027-01-15 UTC.

cases.question: What will be the final non-missing US 10-year constant maturity Treasury yield observation dated in December 2026?
cases.criteria: Use the latest nonmissing December 2026 observation of Federal Reserve H.15 DGS10, in percent, as shown in FRED on 2027-01-15 UTC.

cases.question: Which interval will contain the monthly observed sunspot number for December 2026?
cases.criteria: Use the December 2026 ssn (observed monthly sunspot number, not smoothed or predicted) in NOAA SWPC observed-solar-cycle-indices.json as of 2027-01-31 UTC. Below 80; 80 inclusive to below 140; 140 or greater.

cases.question: Will the last ECB USD per EUR reference rate dated in December 2026 be at least 1.15?
cases.criteria: YES if the final published daily observation dated in December 2026 of EXR.D.USD.EUR.SP00.A is >=1.15 USD per EUR, as seen on 2027-01-15 UTC; otherwise NO.
